channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District on Saturday released investigative reports detailing allegations of hazing and workplace misconduct that led to the termination of 3 firefighters and the suspension of 2 others. item.title: Lightning strike sparks brush fire on Castinet Lane in Port St. Lucie during Friday storms
item.description: Severe weather Friday brought waterspouts in Sebastian, a brush fire and house fire in Port St. Lucie, and over 3 inches of rain across the region.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach Regional Airport flights to JFK due to low demand
item.description: The airline will end its route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport on Sept. 9, citing insufficient ridership since the route launched last December.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman wins $5 million jackpot from scratch-off ticket purchased in Fort Pierce
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, claimed a $5 million top prize from the $5,000,000 CROSSWORD CASH scratch-off game in April and chose a lump-sum payment of $3,262,138.

item.title: Boynton Beach firefighters rescue dog from raw sewage lift station in 4 minutes
item.description: A dog fell roughly 10 to 12 feet into a lift station holding about 2 feet of raw sewage Thursday, prompting a specialized confined space rescue.

item.title: Wellington teen struck by electric bike rider near Lion Country Safari says crash was intentional stunt
item.description: Chad Filer, 17, suffered broken bones and other injuries Tuesday night when an e-bike rider performing a wheelie hit him while he was on his electric scooter.

item.title: Waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires hit Treasure Coast in severe weather outbreak
item.description: Severe weather battered the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County on Friday, bringing waterspouts, lightning strikes and multiple fires to communities across the region. item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route due to low demand, last flights in September
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with goals from Enzo Fernandez and Lautaro Martinez to defeat England 2-1 Wednesday and advance to the World Cup final against Spain.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 time in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 Saturday in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's 27-year-old world record of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent artificial intelligence from helping make in-game decisions.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey with Trump attending
item.description: The World Cup final between Argentina and Spain Sunday in New Jersey will include beefed-up Secret Service security with President Trump attending the trophy presentation.

item.title: Messi bathed Spain star Yamal as baby in 2007 photo shoot before World Cup final
item.description: Photographer Joan Monfort took photos in 2007 of teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal in a plastic bathtub for a charity calendar. The two now face off in Sunday's World Cup final.

item.title: Flip City gymnasts from Florida earn top 15 national finish, advance to Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee, qualifying for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month.
